summary: A 75-foot steel tower raised in 1929 on Whitney Hill in Aroostook County; a storage shed was added in 1967-68, but its fate since is undocumented.

events.note: 75-foot steel tower erected on Whitney Hill in Macwahoc Plantation, Mattawamkeag District, reported that April as planned for that summer
Wood storage shed built at the Whitney Hill tower, per the 1967-68 (37th) Biennial Report of the Forest Commissioner

evidence.supports: built 1929, 75-foot steel tower, Macwahoc Plantation, Mattawamkeag District
evidence.quote: A new lookout station will be erected this summer. A 75 foot steel tower on Whitney Hill in Macwahoc Plantation, Mattawamkeag District.
Built wood and storage shed at Whitney Hill tower.

notes_for_editor: Only source found is the Eastern US Lookouts page, which itself just quotes a 1929 newspaper item and the 1967-68 Forest Commissioner's biennial report. No NHLR or FFLOS register page exists for this site (nhlr.org returned 404), and nothing was found on current status, access, staffing, or whether the tower still stands. The tower record's location (45.65887, -68.18754, from FFLA) was not independently corroborated against the 1929 'Macwahoc Plantation' description within this budget; worth a closer look if a human researcher has more time.
